scope: Compact evidence index; historical raw timing reports remain immutable and are referenced by exact SHA-256. Historical stages and exact formatted-final target/control comparisons remain separate.

method.primary: median(current elapsedMs / baseline elapsedMs) over exact within-report sample pairs in saved selected windows; compute at full float precision
method.secondary: ratio of separate elapsed medians is reported separately; never substitute based on favorable result
method.uncertainty: Single-machine synthetic workloads, one invocation per report, non-independent sequential samples. MAD/range are descriptive; no confidence or regression threshold manufactured. A/A and reverse-repeat controls bound but do not eliminate temporal/runtime confounding.
method.provenance: Preserve frozen manifest source commit/workingTree exactly; dirty snapshots can predate later commit. Original comparisons change host+Core; same-host stage ablations better isolate Core changes.
method.latencyScope: End-to-end guest execution batches. Warm timing excludes first-use compile; x87 later also excludes early tiering. Do not combine ratios across different invocations as if paired.
method.profiles: Fresh ed95 profiles only for mechanism hints. Older c09/2cc profiles do not identify final delivered artifacts.

units.nsPerGuestInstruction: elapsed milliseconds * 1000000 / exact semantic guest instruction count; public-run time, not hardware cycles

semanticWorkAudit: Every selected pair in this index matched recorded final architectural state (x87) or iterations/retired/reason (paging); expected work definitions are in protocol records. conclusions: A2/B retain numeric semantics and together recover both selected x87/MMX target kernels relative to original in Node and Chrome.
C default mask remains live, ordered after DE legality; caller metadata clears and exceptional slow paths remain required.
F immutable borrow is synchronous: no returned bank reference, host reentry, control publication or PDPTE lifetime extension.
D/E were rejected despite intended code/layout changes. G/H were rejected despite substantially smaller hot callers; caller size alone is not proof of performance improvement.

Before I, F versus original remained about 2-4% slower in Node selected warm pairs while Chrome is about 0-0.8% slower; reverse-repeat and A/A controls support a Node residual, not a universal runtime claim.

For F/original Node, recorded executionMs ratios reproduce elapsed ratios while non-execution overhead is about 0.05-0.08 ms on multi-ms batches; snapshots/finish overhead cannot explain that residual.

I/F has identical semantic work and complete native resource counters, same host hash, and multi-ms samples far above timer granularity. It removes redundant physical observations rather than reducing guest work; final formatted Core670a46 must be measured separately from historical I06a12.
Binary diagnostic file ring64-outline-walk-geometry-binary.json was overwritten by H: classify its stale key G by SHA. True G identity and summary are preserved separately.
